name: Google Analytics
shortInfo: Collect, configure, and analyze your data to reach the right audience.
brief:
Google Analytics Connector lets you load data from the Google Analytics 4 API automatically into your data warehouse. This lets you keep track and provides reports on website traffic, collect, configure, and analyze your data to reach the right audience.

The API provides these key features:

##### Metric expressions

The API allows you to request not only built-in metrics but also combination of metrics expressed in mathematical operations. For example, you can use the expression ga:goal1completions/ga:sessions to request the goal completions per number of sessions.

##### Multiple date ranges

The API allows you in a single request to get data in two date ranges.

##### Cohorts and Lifetime value

The API has a rich vocabulary to request Cohort and Lifetime value reports.

##### Multiple segments

The API enables you to get multiple segments in a single request.

availableData:
[Active Users](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/pipelines/active-users.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve active users for increments of 1, 7, 14, and 28 days, and stay abreast of the level of user enthusiasm for your site or app.

[Behavior](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/pipelines/behavior.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve insights into visitor engagement

[Campaign Metrics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/pipelines/campaign-metrics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve performance statistics information about the campaign

[Cohort Analysis](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/pipelines/cohort-analysis.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve isolated and analyzed cohort behavior

[Custom](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/pipelines/custom.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve custom metrics and dimensions of your choosing.

[Demographics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/pipelines/demographics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the age and gender of the website visitors.

[Geo](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/pipelines/geo.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve visitor information such as language and geographic location

[Traffic Metrics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/pipelines/traffic-metrics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed insights into various traffic sources and other related metrics.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/google-analytics/index.html) here.
